note: Both sets are drawn accurately from Table 5.5-5 and largely bind values to the correct channel and row, with roughly equal coverage breadth. Set B is more systematic (all three pixel resolutions, all five wavelength bands, spectrometer types, DM actuator pitch) and preserves the 2.4 λ/D condition on the IWA claims, which Set A drops. Set A adds OWA values, the IR spectrometer resolution (40) and the Red FOV, but it more often misbinds spectrometer-row values to the channel as a whole (1/4 CCD282 as the Blue/Red "detector", 2048 as the channel "Array width"), producing contradictory same-attribute pairs, and it adds a trivial "HabEx 4-Meter Baseline Design" condition on the OWA claims. Set B's only real flaw is the same section-qualifier ambiguity on the 2048 array-width claims plus one redundant IR array-width entry.
